name: Our own evolved strategies (frozen cohort)
rules: Hypothesis: at least one strategy family has a positive expected value after costs. Favourite named in advance: mean reversion (RSI).
Only trades of the frozen cohort opened after the start date count.
Trades on the same day, in the same direction and in the same asset class count as one event.
One verdict at 50 events: passed if the average is above 0 R and t >= 2.2.
Early stop only for losses: from 20 events at t <= -2.5, or at a total of -15 R.
After 8 weeks every undecided family counts as failed.
Rules and cohort are not changed during the experiment.
